name: fighter
lore:
The Fighter is a creature of refined grit, found wherever steel is forged and blood is spilt. They are the most adaptable of our kind, flourishing in soot-stained barracks, gilded courts, and the mud of the frontier. Unlike those who lean on fickle deities or volatile magics, the Fighter draws power from the grueling repetition of the blade.

In the wild, they serve as the party’s anchor. Observe their stillness before a skirmish; it is the calculated silence of a drawn bowstring. They master the "geometry of violence," dictating the tempo of battle through posture and poise. Whether clad in scarred leather or interlocking plate, they are the iron hinge upon which the fate of an expedition turns. They do not wait for destiny to find them; they carve it out of the air with disciplined strikes and an unbreakable will.
